svg.text: Didelphis virginiana — a running trot. 12 phases, 42 ms apart.
Dottie Docket in the Ask Dottie thinking spinner. One stride, 500 ms: near hind with far fore (phases 1 to 5), then far hind with near fore (7 to 11); all four feet off the ground in phases 6 and 12.
Footfalls across the stride: a bar while a foot is on the ground. Each is down for 9 of the rig’s 24 poses; a fore foot lands one pose after its diagonal hind foot.

She runs inside a ring, as in the spinner; its lowest stretch is the ground. Lines every 6° of track (4.7 px of the 96 px spinner), heavier every 18° (half a stride); arcs every 10 px above the ground.
The grid is fixed to the ground and turns back 3° a phase as she runs, so a planted paw keeps its line. The far-side (left) legs are darker.
Drawn by the spinner’s own rig (src/features/ask/dottie.js, posed by tools/ask/run-cycle.mjs) with tools/ask/dottie-sheet.mjs.
